name: codevibez
description: Shows what your coding agent does in plain English, in place of Claude Code's raw tool rows, with a light over the running step, a settle into color and a story pane that rolls new lines in

shimmer.title: Running step shimmer
shimmer.description: on: while a step runs, its sentence dims a little and a soft light sweeps across it, left to right, until the step finishes; a group of reads and searches gets it too while one of them runs. Destructive steps never shimmer. off: a running step's sentence is still, ending in ….

settle.title: Settle into color
settle.description: on: when a step finishes, its ✓, ✗ or ■ line fades from dim into its green, red or yellow in 0.3 s, once. Needs the fullscreen layout; on the main screen the line takes its color at once. off: the color shows at once.

storyRoll.title: Story roll-in
storyRoll.description: on: in the /codevibez story pane, the lines added since it last drew type themselves in one after another (the newest 8, 0.2 s each); failures and destructive steps appear whole. off: new lines appear at once.
